# cubepath_nat_gateways (Data Source)

Lists the organization's NAT gateways.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

- `project_id` (Number) Only list the NAT gateways of this project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `nat_gateways` (Attributes List) NAT gateways. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nat_gateways))
